case_title: VELMA HORN-CANTRELL VS. AUSTIN EVAN RAMOS

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,469.50 FILED BY HORN-CANTRELL, VELMA AS TO DEFENDANT RAMOS, AUSTIN EVAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-27-2018 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-27-2018. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT WAIVED SERVICE PROCESS. AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE HEARING, THE COURT TAKES THIS MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. PLAINTIFF EXHIBIT IS RETAINED BY THE COURT. JUDGE CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA; MATTER NOT REPORTED.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-27-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HORN-CANTRELL, VELMA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RAMOS, AUSTIN EVAN $1,601.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,676.00, ($1,401.00 PLUS COSTS, AND $200.00 FOR PAIN AND SUFFERING). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS, SEE JUDGMENT ATTACHED PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
